snippet.title: Necrophosis: Subconsciousness - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Necrophosis Subconsciousness Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837860/Necrophosis__Subconsciousness/

The descent goes deeper.
Necrophosis: Subconsciousness is the brand-new DLC expansion for Necrophosis, coming to PC via Steam. Return to the realm of decay as new landscapes unfold, new entities emerge, and darker layers of this twisted world reveal themselves.

The core of Necrophosis remains — exploration, item discovery, poem collection, and mind-bending puzzles — but nothing here will feel familiar.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2019760/Necrophosis
